overview_description.description: Stewdio is a design and marketing studio that supports businesses with visual identity, websites, and ongoing digital growth. The company creates branding and identity systems including logos, color palettes, typography, illustrations, and brand guideline documents. Stewdio designs and builds custom Squarespace websites, then provides website management, content updates, and technical maintenance. Its marketing services include search engine optimization, Google and Meta ad campaign management, profile setup on major platforms, and analytics dashboards in Looker Studio. The studio also delivers graphic design for print and digital assets, social media templates, signage, and apparel design, and sells branded merchandise such as stickers, shirts, and hoodies. Stewdio works with small businesses, churches, and other local organizations that want consistent branding and measurable online visibility.
